voice.summary: Letterbox sounds like a type nerd with a sense of humour: tight labels, live values and a love for tiny details. It rewards poking around and prints the CSS to prove it.
dos: Use type words exactly: tracking, leading, weight, slant
Show the live value beside every slider
Make jokes about letters, never about users
donts: Do not say fonts when you mean typefaces
Avoid decorating copy with its own effects

taglines: Tweak the letters, copy the CSS
boilerplate: Letterbox is an interactive type playground with sliders for size, weight, tracking and slant, plus animation presets and one-click CSS export for designers and developers.
